## Constitution Compliance (Always Include)

<!-- These items verify adherence to constitutional principles -->

### Code Quality

- [ ] CHK-CQ001 All functions/classes have single, clear responsibility
- [ ] CHK-CQ002 Code is self-documenting with clear variable/function names
- [ ] CHK-CQ003 No code duplication; repeated logic extracted to reusable functions
- [ ] CHK-CQ004 All error states handled explicitly with actionable error messages
- [ ] CHK-CQ005 Type safety enforced (if applicable)

### User Experience Consistency

- [ ] CHK-UX001 All UI components follow design system (colors, typography, spacing)
- [ ] CHK-UX002 Interaction patterns consistent across feature
- [ ] CHK-UX003 Loading states for actions >200ms
- [ ] CHK-UX004 Error messages are clear, non-technical, actionable
- [ ] CHK-UX005 WCAG 2.1 Level AA compliance (keyboard nav, screen reader, contrast)

### Performance Requirements

- [ ] CHK-PF001 Page load completes within 2 seconds (standard broadband)
- [ ] CHK-PF002 Time to interactive within 3 seconds
- [ ] CHK-PF003 API p95 response time <500ms (read), <1s (write)
- [ ] CHK-PF004 Client memory usage <100MB for typical sessions
- [ ] CHK-PF005 UI maintains 60fps during interactions

### Quality Gates

- [ ] CHK-QG001 Code passes linting with zero errors
- [ ] CHK-QG002 Code auto-formatted with project formatter
- [ ] CHK-QG003 Static type analysis passes (if applicable)
- [ ] CHK-QG004 All tests pass; new features include tests
- [ ] CHK-QG005 Performance budgets not exceeded
- [ ] CHK-QG006 User-facing changes include updated documentation
- [ ] CHK-QG007 Test coverage >80%; critical paths at 100%
- [ ] CHK-QG008 Cyclomatic complexity ≤10 for all functions
- [ ] CHK-QG009 Dependencies reviewed for security vulnerabilities
